title: ChatGPT
before: Aligned instruction-following models existed, reachable through a developer API.
problem: Nobody outside the industry had a reason or a way to use one.
breakthrough: The same RLHF technique in a free chat box, with dialogue-formatted training data and a conversational memory.
why: No new capability, and the biggest inflection in the field's history. It was a distribution and interface breakthrough.
next: GPT-4 and Claude followed as products; every lab reorganised around assistants.
inherits: Chat as the default interface to a language model.
